description: This file contains test classes for gateway connection handling in an Orleans distributed application, including reconnection behavior and cluster mismatch scenarios. It also defines a custom implementation of IGatewayListProvider.

classes.name: TestGatewayManager
classes.description: A test implementation of IGatewayListProvider, providing a list of gateways with a fixed maximum staleness and updatable flag.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionTests
classes.description: Contains test methods for validating gateway connection behaviors such as reconnection attempts and rejection of different cluster connections.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo host for testing, setting clustering options and defining silo port and gateway port.

classes.name: ClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder, setting up gateway list, refresh period, and dependency injection for the gateway provider.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the silo host with local clustering for tests.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the client builder with gateway list and service dependencies.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test class and retrieves the runtime client.

methods.name: NoReconnectionToGatewayNotReturnedByManager
methods.description: Tests that the client does not reconnect to a gateway removed by the gateway manager, and verifies connection attempts.

methods.name: ConnectionFromDifferentClusterIsRejected
methods.description: Tests that a connection attempt from a different cluster is rejected with an appropriate exception.
